Yes. You can export your data at any time, and it's included on the free plan, so you don't need to upgrade.

You can download your data as CSV or JSON. CSV is the one to pick if you want to open your transactions in a spreadsheet program like Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers, where you can sort, filter and run your own analysis. JSON suits developers, or moving your data into another app or tool that accepts structured data.

Even a large history of 10,000 transactions exports in under two minutes, and smaller accounts usually finish in a few seconds. You can keep using the app while the export runs.

To start an export, open your account settings and find the data or export section. Choose CSV or JSON and confirm. When the file is ready, save it to your device.

The data is yours, and you can export it as often as you like for a backup, to review your spending somewhere else, or to move to a different service. There are no limits or extra fees.
